# Starter revision 3.2 fixture

Exact copies, taken at commit d40dc32, of the files that made up the revision 3.2
startup route: the installed AGENTS.md bridge, START.md, DIRECTOR.md, OPERATIONS.md,
WORKER.md, the checker and the manifest. Tests use them to build a 3.2 installation
and move it to the current revision. They are test data, not instructions; do not
edit them.
